bill.constitutionalAuthorityStatementText:
[Congressional Record Volume 172, Number 147 (Thursday, September 17, 2026)]
[House]
From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]
By Mr. CASTEN:
H.R. 10488.
Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuant
to the following:
Article I, Section 8, clause 3 of the Constitution
[Page H5989]

latestAction.text: Referred to the Committee on Energy and Commerce, and in addition to the Committees on Transportation and Infrastructure, Agriculture, Natural Resources, and Science, Space, and Technology, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.

bill.title: To restore and strengthen the obligation of the Environmental Protection Agency to protect human health and the environment, to halt unlawful deregulatory actions, to require enforcement of the Clean Air Act, and for other purposes.
